svg.title: The whole series as nested layers. Part 2 built the loop: the model asks for a tool, your code runs it, and the context grows. Part 3 wrapped that loop in a stateless agent: one State in, a new State out, with prompts in files. Part 4 wrapped the agent in an API with launch, state, pause, resume and provide_input, saved in SQLite. Part 1's rules shaped all of them.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
